name: non-POU domain containing octamer binding

function.text: NONO encodes non-POU domain-containing octamer-binding protein). Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding and lncRNA binding. It participates in RNA splicing and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked syndromic intellectual disability (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic 34 (x-linked).

somatic.text: NONO can participate in TFE3-associated rearrangements in renal cell carcinoma.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
